_help: Units shown in the portal. Each unit is ONE lesson with three steps at the top: Watch (MP4) → Play (HTML game) → Read (HTML notes).
Paths are relative to the "Saturday Sprint" folder; npm run build copies the files into the site (public/packs/). No cloud storage.
Admins can replace or add any step later in Admin → Learning bytes (Watch: .mp4, Play and Read: .html). Read can be left out here.
mode "replace": these units replace the original units of each course listed. "append": added after them.
course: pf (Programming Foundations) or genai (Intro to GenAI). Unit ids must be unique and must not change once students have progress.
practiceTopic (optional): the Practice topic (session name) that belongs to this unit, for Student analytics. Without it, a topic with the same name as the unit title is used.

watch.goal: Watch. A condition inside another condition.
watch.concept: Nest conditions, use elif for one of many paths, and never write elif after else.

play.goal: Play the levels: the winning team, find the greatest, divisible by what?

watch.goal: Watch. A for loop runs for every item.
watch.concept: Loop over strings and range(), build patterns, and trace each pass.

play.goal: Play the levels: write it once, loop over a word, range(), pick the triangle.

watch.goal: Watch. Every character has a Unicode value.
watch.concept: Use ord() and chr(), compare strings character by character, and name variables in snake_case.

play.goal: Play the levels: characters are numbers, Unicode ranges, A vs B, character by character.

watch.goal: Watch. Every GenAI app runs on an LLM.
watch.concept: What LLMs are, pre-trained vs fine-tuned, open vs closed models, and Hugging Face.

play.goal: Play the levels: the car analogy, what it takes to build an LLM, sort the models.

watch.goal: Watch. From 45 minutes by hand to 2 minutes.
watch.concept: An AI workflow is a predefined sequence of input, tasks and output; in n8n each step is a node.

play.goal: Play the levels: define a workflow, article to post, fixed or free?

watch.goal: Watch. From 30 minutes of browsing to a 2-minute newsletter.
watch.concept: Merge and aggregate feeds, and use APIs like SERP API to bring in live data.

play.goal: Play the levels: rebuild the workflow, add a third source, APIs at the restaurant.
